title: codenames — Overview
content:
Analysis performed in response to: "Explore the codebase at /Users/yiumich/Repos/codenames to understand:
1. What kind of application is this? (language, framework, runtime)
2. What's the project structure? (key directories and files)
3. How is it built and run? (package.json scripts, Dockerfile, docker-compose, etc.)
4. Any existing deployment or infrastructure config?

Return a concise summary covering these points."

### 2. Project structure
```
codenames/
├── package.json              # Root workspace: "concurrently" runs both server + client
├── .gitignore                # Ignores node_modules, dist, .DS_Store, .env, *.log
├── .vscode/settings.json     # Snyk auto-select config
│
├── client/                   # React SPA (Vite)
│   ├── package.json          # Deps: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, socket.io-client
│   ├── vite.config.js        # Dev proxy: /socket.io -> localhost:3001
│   ├── index.html            # SPA shell
│   ├── dist/                 # Vite build output (gitignored)
│   └── src/
│       ├── main.jsx          # App entry: routes = "/" (Home) and "/room/:code" (Room)
│       ├── socket.js         # Singleton socket.io client, sends playerId from localStorage
│       ├── identity.js       # Generates/persists a stable playerId in localStorage
│       ├── styles.css         # All styling (dark theme, board grid, cards, lobby)
│       ├── pages/
│       │   ├── Home.jsx      # Create/join room, nickname, dev "solo test" button
│       │   └── Room.jsx      # Joins a room by code, renders Lobby or Game based on phase
│       └── components/
│           ├── Lobby.jsx     # Team selection, spymaster assignment, start button
│           └── Game.jsx      # 5x5 board, clue giving, card selection/reveal, turn logic
│
└── server/                   # Node.js backend
    ├── package.json          # Deps: express, cors, socket.io, nanoid
    └── src/
        ├── index.js          # Express + Socket.IO server, all event handlers, identity bookkeeping
        ├── rooms.js          # Game logic: room CRUD, teams, clues, card reveals, win conditions
        └── words.js          # Static word list (~280 Codenames-style words)
```
